name: StickerByVIN
description: Checks whether a car's original window sticker (Monroney label) is on file for a VIN. Decodes the vehicle (year, make, model, trim, engine, drivetrain, plant), gives the model's recall count with NHTSA's open-recall link, and says where the paint code is printed. One read-only tool, check_window_sticker. Free with no key.
author: StickerByVIN
